verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a recurring job in plain language and choose to run it 'on a schedule or in response to an event' (linear-docs-11, linear-docs-36), directly matching automatic event-triggered actions; this is reinforced by webhook support (webhookCreate mutation, linear-docs-51/52) and event subscriptions in project views (linear-docs-61) for building custom trigger-based automations.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Loops' event-trigger reliability and detail on the range of conditions/events supported.
